instruction: `newest` must return the highest published version, not the first or the lexically largest. Skip drafts, prereleases and tags that do not parse as vX.Y.Z. Return null when none qualify.
provenance: hexa self-update, 2026-09-15: trusted GitHub's 'latest' flag, which is the most recently created release. Two tags pushed together would have downgraded every machine. ADR-2609151700.
